name: Gaudi ~Barcelona no Kaze~
original_name: ガウディ ～バルセロナの風～
source:
While the whole world enjoying Olympics of 1992 in Barcelona a catalonian political unrest grows in the very heart of the city. You are consultant sent to settle matters with local separatists.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
1992年，全世界都在享受巴塞罗那奥运会的盛况，加泰罗尼亚的政治动荡却在城市中心不断加剧。你是一名受命前来的顾问，任务是解决当地分离主义势力引发的问题。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
